messages.text: Hi Theo! I'm Venus, the university's assistant. I can help you change your classes and will remind you of important dates coming up during the semester.
If you want to change classes, you have until Friday, February 13 — the add/drop deadline — to change it. The button below will take you to the scheduling website.
Keep in mind that you need at least 3 regular classes plus a PE class to stay enrolled, 7 classes at most, and if you drop a class you won't be able to enroll in it again this semester.
Concordia et Prosperitas. Welcome to campus!
Hey Theo, did you know that there are many places on and off-campus that hire VU students?
Part-time employment isn't just a great way to put some extra dollars in your pocket. It's also a fun way to improve skills and meet people.
Interested? I can help you apply for a part-time job. Just click the button below.
How's your first week been, Theo? Remember to keep up with your coursework! By the way, there are two types of classes: lecture classes and project classes.

For lecture classes, you'll have a midterm and a final. Study hard and improve your Brains if you want a good grade. And if your professor says something will be on an exam, you should probably note it down.

For project classes, you'll have a final showcase instead of an exam. If you work on your project every week, you'll avoid having to crunch when the deadline approaches. And it definitely helps to have high Heart so you can present your project effectively.
Midterms run March 2 to March 6. Good luck! Wishing you "Concordia et Prosperitas."
